content.text:
I fixed it. The "Add to cart" buttons on the products page had white text on a white background, so the labels were invisible.

The cause was in `site/css/components.css`. `.btn-secondary` had `color: var(--color-surface)`, which is the same as its background. I changed it to `var(--color-ink)`.

The same button style is used on the home, pricing and orders pages, so those were failing the visual tests too. All 12 visual tests now pass, on desktop and phone. I didn't run the functional tests, since this was only a CSS color change.

STATUS: DONE
